description: Python polyfills for operator functions such as attrgetter, itemgetter, methodcaller, and countOf, including type annotations and decorators.

methods.name: attrgetter
methods.description: Creates a getter function for specified attributes, supporting nested attributes separated by dots.

methods.name: itemgetter
methods.description: Creates a getter function for specified items from a collection.

methods.name: methodcaller
methods.description: Creates a function that calls a named method with specified arguments on an object.

methods.name: countOf
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of an element in an iterable.
